The system warns the driver of obstacles located behind the vehicle during the parking manoeuvre. It assists the
driver during parking by sensing obstacles also situated outside the driver's field of view.
The information regarding the presence and distance of an obstacle is transmitted to the driver in the form of
acoustic and visible signals. The acoustic signal may be pulsed at a rate depending on distance.

1.11.1Parking Assistance System Management
1.11.1.1PAM Requirements
1.11.1.1.1 Variable Definition
1.11.1.1.1.1 Reverse Condition
Reverse Condition is True IF:
the PROXI parameter Gear_Box_Type is different from “MTX” AND the signal TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition
is equal to "R" for a time greater than TReverseGear.
1.11.1.1.1.2 Standstill Condition
Standstill Condition is True IF:
the signal BRAKE4.VehicleStandStillSts is equal to "True".
1.11.1.1.1.3 KEY ON Variable
The internal variable KEY ON is defined in order to indicate the following ignition states:
- Ignition_ON
- Ignition_Start
- Ignition_ON_Engine_ON
1.11.1.1.1.4 KEY OFF Variable
The internal variable KEY OFF is defined in order to indicate the following ignition states:
- Ignition_OFF
- Initialization
1.11.1.1.1.5 MODE_PAM Variable
The internal variable MODE_PAM is defined in order to store the last PAM activation state before the transition
from KEY ON to KEY OFF. It can assume the following possible values:
- ON
- OFF
The initial value at Power ON is OFF
1.11.1.1.1.6 PAMFault Variable
The internal variable PAMFault is defined in order to store a failure status. It can assume the following possible
values:
- TRUE: when a fault occurs
- FALSE: when no faults occur

slides.title: 1.11.1.1.2 PAM State Machine
slides.body:
Fiat Group Automobilies
R&D
Project: 332BEV Ed. 2 Rev. A
The following State machine is defined in order to define the PAM Algorithm behaviour:
--------------- Create the State Machine ------------------
KEY OFF State Description
In the "KEY OFF" State,
- IF the signal PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON", "Ignition_Start",
"Ignition_ON_Engine_ON"
THEN PAM shall move to "KEY ON" state.
KEY ON State Description
When PAM enters the "KEY ON" State,
- PAM shall turn on and perform initialization phase;
- PAM shall set all the signals present in STATUS_PAM and PARK_INFO to their default values,
except for the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts that shall be set to " ON_Inactive ", as init value.
When PAM enters the "KEY ON" State,
- PAM shall wait a time equal to TFilter before considering the input signal TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition as
valid
- during TFilter time, PAM shall consider the signal TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition equal to "P"
In the "KEY ON" State,
PAM shall load from its non volatile memory the last status, according to the internal variables MODE_PAM
and PAMFault :
- IF the internal variable MODE_PAM is equal to "ON" AND the internal variable PAMFault is equal
to "False"
THEN PAM shall:
move to the "ON_Enable" state
- IF the internal variable MODE_PAM is equal to "OFF" AND the internal variable PAMFault is equal
to "False"
THEN PAM shall:
move to the "OFF" state
- IF the internal variable PAMFault is equal to "True"
THEN PAM shall:
move to the "Disable" state
In the "KEY ON" State,
- IF the signal PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_OFF" or "Initialization"
THEN PAM shall move to "KEY OFF" state.
PAM ON_Enable State Description
When PAM enters the "ON_Enable" State, it shall
- set the internal variable PAMFault to "False"
- check if the Reverse Condition is verified:
- IF Reverse Condition is equal to False
THEN
PAM shall move to the "ON_Inactive" Substate.
15/34

slides.title: Fiat Group Automobilies R&D Project: 332BEV Ed. 2 Rev. A · IF Reverse Condition is equal to True THEN PAM shall move to
slides.body:
R&D
PAM shall move to the "ON_Active" Substate.
In the "ON_Enable" state,
IF one of the following conditions is verified:
- (the signal BRAKE1.VehicleSpeedVSOSig becomes greater than SPEED_LIMIT AND Reverse
Condition is equal to True) OR
- the hardwire signal Trailer.Info is equal to "Present" OR
- PAMFault becomes equal to "True" (see Diagnosis and Recovery Requirements)
PAM shall move to "Disable" state.
In the "ON_Enable" state,
IF the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts switches to "Pressed"
PAM shall move to the "OFF" state.
- PAM ON_Inactive SubState Description
When PAM enters the "ON_Inactive" Substate, PAM shall:
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts to " ON_Inactive "
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.RearSensorSts to "Active"
- set the internal variable MODE_PAM to "ON" and store this value in its non volatile memory
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAM_LedControlSts equal to "OFF"
- set the signal PARK_INFO.DisplayActivation equal to "Not Active"
When PAM is in the ON_Inactive substate,
IF Reverse Condition becomes equal to True
PAM shall move to "ON_Active" substate.
- PAM ON_Active SubState Description
When PAM enters the "ON_Active" Substate, PAM shall:
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts to "ON_Active"
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.RearSensorSts to "Active"
- set the internal variable MODE_PAM to "ON" and store this value in its non volatile memory
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAM_LedControlSts equal to "OFF"
- set the signal PARK_INFO.DisplayActivation equal to "Active"
When PAM is in the "ON_Active" Substate, PAM shall:
set the signals of PARK_INFO message according to the table reported in Visual Alerts Table Paragraph.
- In the "ON_Active" substate, IF:
- Standstill Condition is equal to "True" AND
- an obstacle results continuously moving across two consecutive arcs
PAM shall:
- activate acoustic and visual warnings considering the closest position unless the obstacle is detected
in a different zone continuously for T_Filter_Alerts
16/34

slides.title: Fiat Group Automobilies R&D Project: 332BEV Ed. 2 Rev. A In the "ON_Active" substate, IF Reverse Condition becomes equal
slides.body:
R&D
IF Reverse Condition becomes equal to False
THEN
PAM shall move to "ON_Inactive" substate.
PAM Disable State Description
When PAM enters the "Disable" state, PAM shall:
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts to "ON_Disabled"
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAM_LedControlSts to "Continous light"
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMAboveSpeed to "True", only IF
(the signal BRAKE1.VehicleSpeedVSOSig is greater than SPEED_LIMIT AND Reverse Condition is
equal to True)
In the "Disable" state,
IF the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts switches to "Pressed" AND the internal variable PAMFault is
equal to "TRUE"
THEN
PAM shall:
- remain in the "Disable" state
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts equal to "Blinking light" for a time equal to
PAM_LED_BLINK_TIME and then set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts equal to
"Continuous light"
In the "Disable" state,
IF the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts switches to "Pressed"AND the internal variable PAMFault is
equal to "FALSE"
THEN
PAM shall move to the "OFF" state.
In the "Disable" state,
IF one of the following condition is verified:
- [(the signal BRAKE1.VehicleSpeedVSOSig becomes lower than SPEED_LIMIT AND Reverse
Condition is equal to True) AND the internal variable PAMFault is equal to "False"] OR
- the hardwire signal Trailer.Info is different from "Present" AND the internal variable PAMFault is
equal to "False" OR
- the internal variable PAMFault is equal to "False"
THEN
PAM shall move to "ON_Enable" substate.
PAM OFF State Description
When PAM enters the "OFF" state, PAM shall:
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemSts to "OFF"
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.RearSensorSts to "Active"
- set the internal variable MODE_PAM to "OFF" and store this value in its non volatile memory
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAM_LedControlSts to "Continous light"
In the OFF state,
IF the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts switches to "Pressed" AND the internal variable PAMFault is
equal to "TRUE"
THEN
PAM shall:
- move to "Disable" state.
17/34

slides.title: 1.11.1.1.3 PAM - Chime Requirements 1.11.1.2 LSS Requirements 1.11.1.2.1 Switch Acquisition
slides.body:
Fiat Group Automobilies
R&D
Project: 332BEV Ed. 2 Rev. A
In the OFF state,
IF the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts switches to "Pressed" AND the internal variable PAMFault is
equal to "FALSE"
THEN
PAM shall move to "ON_Enable" state.
In the ON_Active state, PAM shall set the following signals:
- PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_LHR
- PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_RHR
according to the rules below:
Obstacle location Signals value
Rear Left Zone PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_LHR equal to "Active"
PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_RHR equal to "Not Active"
Rear Central Zone PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_LHR equal to "Active"
PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_RHR equal to "Active"
Rear Right Zone PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_LHR equal to "Not Active"
PARK_INFO.ChimeActivation_RHR equal to "Active"
PAM shall:
- set the signal PARK_INFO.ChimeType_Rear to "Type4"
- set the signal PARK_INFO.ChimeRepetitionRate_Rear according to the following rules:
- repetition rate shall vary linearly with the obstacle distance
- pulse duration between two chimes shall assume variable values between
REP_MIN_DURATION and REP_MAX_DURATION
- continuous tone shall correspond to the value 0
WALL DETECTION
IF following devices:
- R_Bumper_Left_Parking.Sensor
- R_Bumper_Right_Parking.Sensor
detect "wall shaped obstacle" (see definition in FTS document) continously for more than Tpamwalldet
THEN
PAM shall deactivate the acoustic feedback as long as the obstacle is detected.
MULTIPLE OBSTACLES - CHIME MANAGEMENT
1) IF more obstacles are detected in the same zone,
THEN
only the nearest obstacle shall be acoustically signalled.
2) IF more obstacles are detected in different zones, in the Rear Detection Area
THEN
the nearest obstacle shall be acoustically signalled

1.11.1.3BCM Algorithm Requirements
The following requirements shall be implemented only if the PROXI parameter Can Node 24 is set to "Present"
IF the signal BCM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_On" or "Ignition_Start" or
"Ignition_On_Engine_On"
THEN

THEN
BCM shall set the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts equal to "Pressed"

THEN
BCM shall set the signal LIN_BCM_IGW1.PAMRequestSts equal to "Not Pressed"
IF the signal BCM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_On" or "Ignition_Start" or

Following requirements have to be considered as sub-set diagnosis requirements (usually correlated to the system
functionality).
Any other specific diagnosis requirement is included in the “PAM - Diagnostic Requirements” document for the
system itself.
1.12.2.1PAM Requirements
IF PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON" or "Ignition_On_Engine_On" AND PAM detects a
failure in one of the following devices:
- R_Bumper_Left_Parking.Sensor
- R_Bumper_Right_Parking.Sensor
- R_Bumper_Central_Parking.Sensor
for the period indicated in "PAM - Diagnostic Requirements" document,
THEN
PAM shall:
- set the proper DTC as long as the failure persists, according to "PAM - Diagnostic Requirements"
document
- set the internal variable PAMFault equal to "True" and store this value in its non volatile memory
When the failure occurs, IF PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON" or
"Ignition_On_Engine_On" AND the PAM is not in the "OFF" state
THEN
PAM shall:
- disable the Parking Assistance functionality
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemFault to "System_Failure"
- move to the "Disabled" state
IF PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON" or "Ignition_On_Engine_On" AND PAM doesn't
detect this failure anymore
THEN
PAM shall:
- Heal the DTC
- set the signal STATUS_PAM.PAMSystemFault to "False"
- move to the "ON_Enable" state
IF PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON" or "Ignition_On_Engine_On" AND PAM detects an
internal failure for the period indicated in "PAM - Diagnostic Requirements" document
THEN
PAM shall:
- set the proper DTC as long as the failure persists, according to "PAM - Diagnostic Requirements"
document
- set the internal variable PAMFault equal to "True" and store this value in its non volatile memory
When the failure occurs, IF PAM_OperationalModeSts.Info is equal to "Ignition_ON" or
"Ignition_On_Engine_On" AND the PAM is not in the "OFF" state
THEN

1.12.3Diagnostic Requirements
1.12.3.1PAM requirements
Before detecting all the faults related to CAN messages, PAM shall wait a time equal to Tign (this parameter shall
be tunable) exiting from the initialisation phase.
1.12.3.1.2 Engineering parameters
A specific parameter in the diagnostic section of the ECU shall be implemented to indicate the presence of a trailer
hook if one is installed.
In case of failure detection, PAM shall store an appropriate DTC in its internal memory and freeze, among
environmental parameters, vehicle speed detected at the fault detection (information available in the signal
VehicleSpeedVSOSig. If VehicleSpeedVSOSigFailSts is set to "Fail Present", then PAM shall store default value of
VehicleSpeedVSOSig.
